name: Zurcher Farms
tagline: Link to Zurcher Farms Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/zurcherfarms
description: In 257 County Road J, NE, Zurcher Farms raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
